exceptions.advisoryTitle: image-size: ICNS parser allows denial of service through an infinite loop
exceptions.reason: Upstream Expo/Metro build-toolchain dependency. No patched image-size release exists (GHSA lists 'Patched versions: None' as of 2026-08-15; image-size@2.0.2 is npm's current latest tag and is still within the vulnerable '<=2.0.2' range for this advisory). Metro's own maintainers attempted three separate migrations to a maintained fork ('image-size-next', PRs #1859, #1853, #1852) and all were abandoned; every Metro release through the current 0.87.0 still declares image-size@^1.0.2. No compatible non-major-upgrade fix exists in the accepted Expo SDK 57 / React Native 0.86 (ADR-0001) line.
exceptions.scope: development-build-toolchain (Metro asset-dimension parsing during local/CI bundling; never executes in the shipped learner app runtime)
exceptions.reviewTrigger: Expo/Metro/image-size patch release, dependency-tree change, exception expiry, or earlier manual Product Owner / Project Architect review
